name: Kihoku (Mie, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kihoku town emblem in green and blue: a green and blue stylised wave with a swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Kihoku, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 October 2005.

features.role: Kihoku town emblem — a green and blue stylised wave with a swirl
